name: zopt_get_camera_mode_player_state
description: zOpt::GetCameraModeAsPlayerCameraState maps the camera-control bit to the player camera-state value expected by Player::ApplyCameraState.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zGame options source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja still shows the original partial-register OR expression; the source keeps the behavior-level mapping.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x407ef0 validates mapping a clear CAMERA_THIRD_PERSON bit to player camera state 3 and a set bit to state 1.
The native smoke verifies both camera-state results while toggling the shared game-control options word.
